```
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is implemented in a non-transitory computer-readable medium and is configured to execute instructions that cause the device to perform the alignment.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and is configured to perform this identification via processing a set of computational operations.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device is configured to provide an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in visually highlighting the current step on the user interface.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device is configured to output an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and is configured to execute instructions to determine the next step.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device is configured to provide an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in visually highlighting the next step on the user interface.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device is configured to output an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, calculated by the alignment device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images in executing its alignment computations.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure by analyzing historical data inputs.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device is configured to use at least some of the captured images to enhance its alignment calculations.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure by processing feedback data.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, executed as part of the alignment computations.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in visually highlighting the current step on the user interface.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, executed using the alignment device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in visually highlighting the next step on the user interface.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, analyzed by the alignment device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, processed by the alignment device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure by evaluating historical outcome data.

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

(Currently Amended) Claim 30: The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, processed for alignment accuracy.

(Currently Amended) Claim 31: The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure through data assessment.
```
